name: captive_drain_serve
description: The real EP3 state: captive ball active in slot 2 (ball_slots_initial; it settles at (232,188)). Ball 0 starts below the drain line. EP3 drain checks slots 1 and 0 only (cs:0763 mov di,4) and serves when both are empty (cs:07A4 cmp cx,2), so ball 0 is served at (297,350) with the captive ball still in play, then plunged. Slot 1 is given at y=400 with active=0 (harness) so that a port which ignores `active` drains it in the same frame-0 drain check.
